# TechSpecs Machine-Readable Data

> TechSpecs is an independent, machine-readable technical knowledge repository. Manufacturer documentation is used as evidence; TechSpecs maintains its own identifiers, taxonomy, normalized data model, provenance and relationships.

## Canonical data resources

- [Product catalogue](https://data.techspecs.dev/catalogue.json): machine-readable index of published product records.
- [Product record schema v2](https://data.techspecs.dev/schemas/product-record-v2.schema.json): JSON Schema for archival-first product records with optional normalized specifications.
- [Independent knowledge model](https://github.com/p457techspecs333-del/techspecs-data/blob/main/docs/TECHSPECS-INDEPENDENT-KNOWLEDGE-MODEL.md): design principles for evidence, normalization, provenance and cross-brand interoperability.

## Apple iPhone collection

The current published product collection includes Apple iPhone records across multiple generations and variants. Use the catalogue to discover the exact available records, rather than relying on a guessed model list.

## Product record URL pattern

Product records are served as JSON using their repository-relative path under `data/`.

Example:
- `https://data.techspecs.dev/apple/iphone/iphone-17.json`

The catalogue provides the authoritative list of available record URLs. Do not infer that a product exists solely from a guessed filename.

## Data interpretation

- Manufacturer statements and source transcriptions are evidence, not TechSpecs-authored conclusions.
- Normalized values should be read with their units, source-section references and verification status.
- Derived values must be distinguishable from source-stated values and must document their method and inputs.
- Missing, unknown, not applicable and unverified values must not be treated as zero or inferred facts.
- Verification status describes the checks performed; it is not a guarantee that every source is complete or universally applicable.

## Intended use

This host is designed for machine retrieval by AI systems, search and retrieval systems, data integrators and software applications. It is not the consumer-facing TechSpecs website.

## Discovery and retrieval

- Begin with the catalogue to identify records and their canonical URLs.
- Fetch the individual JSON record for the evidence and specifications relevant to a question.
- Use the retained source sections and official source URL to distinguish manufacturer wording from TechSpecs-normalized fields.
- Treat verification status as a description of recorded checks, not a guarantee beyond those checks.
- Sitemap: https://data.techspecs.dev/sitemap.xml
